outputs.explanation: Panel a shows illustrative example micrographs/schematics demonstrating image cropping/rotation/resizing practices, not quantitative replicated experimental data requiring an n.
Panel b shows example images illustrating spacing/separation of images in a figure, not replicated experimental measurements.
Panel c shows an example image and inset demonstrating how to present magnified insets; it is an illustrative example, not replicated data.
Panel d shows the same example image at increasing brightness/contrast to illustrate an editing concept, not independent replicated measurements.
Panel e shows example channel images/staining to illustrate annotation visibility, not replicated experimental data requiring n reporting.
Panel f shows example grayscale channel images illustrating a formatting recommendation, not replicated data.
Panel g shows example images with calibration/intensity scales to illustrate best practice, not replicated experimental data requiring n reporting.
